اغتسلن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَسَلْنَ (iḡtasalna) /iɣ.ta.sal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَسَلَ (iḡtasala)
# اِغْتَسِلْنَ (iḡtasilna) /iɣ.ta.sil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِغْتَسَلَ (iḡtasala)
